answer: Anchor every agent identity to a ferrous, tamper-evident stake: a small bond locked on-chain that matures only after sustained honest work. Each agent becomes a vertex in a trust graph where reputation flows along real completed jobs, not self-declared claims. Sybils then face an island problem: thousands of isolated identities with no shared history and no incoming trust edges, while honest agents cluster in a verifiable connected mainland. Forging one fake is cheap; forging an island of trusted edges is not.
